hemoglobin.low: May indicate anaemia (low blood). Can cause tiredness and breathlessness.
hemoglobin.high: Higher than normal; can be due to dehydration or smoking. Discuss with your doctor.

fasting glucose.low: Low sugar can cause shakiness and sweating.
fasting glucose.high: Above 100 may suggest pre-diabetes; 126 or more suggests diabetes. Needs doctor review.

post-prandial glucose.low: Low sugar after meals; discuss with your doctor.
post-prandial glucose.high: Sugar after meals is high; may suggest diabetes control issues.

random glucose.low: Low sugar; discuss with your doctor.
random glucose.high: High random sugar; needs doctor review.

hba1c.low: Lower than usual; discuss with your doctor.
hba1c.high: 5.7-6.4 suggests pre-diabetes; 6.5 or above suggests diabetes.

ldl cholesterol.high: 'Bad' cholesterol is high. Raises heart-disease risk.

hdl cholesterol.low: 'Good' cholesterol is low. Exercise and diet can raise it.

triglycerides.high: High triglycerides raise heart and pancreas risk.

creatinine.high: May suggest reduced kidney function. Needs doctor review.
creatinine.low: Usually not a concern; can be seen with low muscle mass.

urea.high: May suggest dehydration or kidney problems.

uric acid.high: High uric acid can cause gout and kidney stones.

wbc.low: May suggest weak immunity or a viral infection.

platelets.low: Low platelets raise bleeding risk (common in dengue).
platelets.high: High platelets can be due to infection or iron deficiency.

vitamin d.low: Vitamin D deficiency can weaken bones.

vitamin b12.low: B12 deficiency can cause tiredness and numbness in hands and feet.

sgot.high: May suggest liver or muscle stress.
